title: Extract a shared pumpApp/l10n test harness — 25+ duplicated MaterialApp+delegate blocks across features/profiles/presentation tests
why: grep -c 'GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate' across the 15 batch files totals 25 occurrences in 13/15 files (7 alone in parent_pin_keypad_dialog_test.dart, 3 each in add_profile_dialog_test.dart and parent_track_management_screen_l1_test.dart) — every widget test hand-rolls its own MaterialApp(locale:, localizationsDelegates: const [4 delegates], supportedLocales:, home:) wrapper. No pumpApp helper exists anywhere in test/ (repo-wide search). This is Fowler-textbook shotgun-surgery risk: adding a 5th delegate, changing supportedLocales, or fixing an RTL default requires touching dozens of call sites, and drift has already started — pp11_edit_dialog_autofocus_test.dart and pp13 write the delegate list without 'const' while most others use 'const ['.
recommendation: Add test/helpers/pump_app.dart exporting a pumpApp(tester, {required Widget child, Locale locale = const Locale('en'), List<Override> overrides = const [], StackRouter? router}) that wraps ProviderScope+MaterialApp+the 4 delegates+supportedLocales once; migrate these 15 files onto it incrementally.
acceptance_criteria: test/helpers/pump_app.dart exists and is imported by at least the files in this batch.
grep -rc 'GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate' test/features/profiles/presentation/ drops from 25 to 0 outside the new shared helper.

corrections: Two unevidenced narrative claims are false: (1) 'No pumpApp helper exists anywhere in test/ (repo-wide search)' is wrong — test/e2e/harness/e2e_harness.dart:304 defines E2EHarness.pumpApp(), used by 30+ e2e journey tests (a different tier, but the claim as stated is inaccurate). (2) 'pp13 write[s] the delegate list without const' is wrong — pp13_add_profile_selects_new_profile_test.dart:85 uses 'localizationsDelegates: const ['. pp11's no-const claim checks out. Confidence lowered to SUSPECTED due to these overreaches; core finding and P2 severity otherwise stand.
